evidence.text: Barbara of Brandenburg- Ansbach- Kulmbach( 24 September 1495 in Ansbach – 23 September 1552 in Karlovy Vary) was a princess of Brandenburg- Ansbach by birth and marriage Landgravine of Leuchtenberg.

evidence.title: Sibylle of Brandenburg
evidence.text: Sibylle of Brandenburg (31 May 1467 in Ansbach – 9 July 1524 in Kaster) was a Princess of Brandenburg by birth and by marriage Duchess of Jülich and Duchess of Berg.

evidence.title: Margaret of Brandenburg (1450–1489)
evidence.text: Margaret of Brandenburg( 1449 or 1450 – 1489) was a princess of Brandenburg by birth and by marriage Duchess of Pomerania.

evidence.title: Barbara of Brandenburg (1464–1515)
evidence.text: Barbara of Brandenburg( 30 May 1464 – 4 September 1515), a member of the German House of Hohenzollern, was by birth Margravine of Brandenburg, and by her two marriages, Duchess of Głogów from 1472 to 1476, and Queen of Bohemia from 1476 to 1490/1500.
